{{Quote|We've got a security breach in the meeting hall area... At least one guard down. Level four alert.|[[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] [[Mirith Sinn]]|<ref name="CEIII">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Grand Meeting Hall''' was a massive section of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Serving both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the enormity of the Grand Meeting Hall was diminished in relation with the [[Grand Corridor]].

==History==
The Grand Meeting Hall had been erected inside the Imperial Palace on Coruscant by [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], serving as a large corridor filled with Imperial diplomats, ambassadors, functionaries, and aide-de-camps during the first days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CNJT" />

Following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation of Coruscant]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] took control of the Imperial Palace and ousted all remaining Imperials from the massive complex's halls. As [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her government resided in the Palace, a band of Imperial raiders infiltrated the Palace in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] as part of a [[Phase One|planned assassination]] attempt on the Chief. At the time [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief]] of [[Palace Guard (New Republic)|the Palace Guard]] [[Mirith Sinn]] was sweeping the Meeting Hall when she discovered the intruders. It was quickly determined that they had been sent by the [[Restored Empire]] and they were successfully thwarted.<ref name="CEIII" />
